summary: A resident says she will oppose any rate rise until named spending is cut or canceled.
realLife: At a town council hearing more than thirty residents spoke about inflation and living costs while the council listened without reply, some openly hostile. The leader of a residents' group said she opposed any increase and tied it to three demands: smaller staff pay, no town hall expansion and an end to developer incentives.
sources: StarNews via Yahoo (Leland, North Carolina), 'Amid cries for no tax increase, Leland asks for less from residents in new budget', Apr 19, 2024: https://www.yahoo.com/news/amid-cries-no-tax-increase-150436491.html
Read whole and coded paragraph by paragraph by a helper in this session (Nov 24, 2026); paraphrased, no sentence copied.
inGame: a town's budget lines for staff pay, buildings and development incentives; a resident group's stated demands; needs: a resident group record with demands

turns.name: the demand is met in part
turns.pulledBy: the council sends the budget back to staff
turns.writes: the story carries the group's demands and what the revised budget dropped

turns.name: the demand is met in none
turns.pulledBy: the council keeps the buildings and incentive lines
turns.writes: the story reports the group still opposing the rise

turns.name: a hostile speaker crosses a line
turns.pulledBy: speakers who speak to jeer rather than to argue
turns.writes: the story notes the tone and that the council did not reply
